description: Shows a text file with line numbers, up to 200 lines per call. Only files inside the allowed folders (such as core_dump, the C sample project, and tools) can be read; list_files without a path shows the allowed folder names.

params.name: path
params.description: File to show, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src/main.c

params.name: count
params.description: How many lines to show, 1 to 200 (default 200)
